title.zh: How I got over 300 Tor exit nodes removed

current_state.zh: A security researcher recounts how they identified and successfully had more than 300 malicious Tor exit nodes delisted, detailing SSH credential-harvesting attacks and Ebury-linked compromised hosting providers behind them.
